title: SEC4: tls_safe_mode branch lacks inline comment
description: In wc_crypto2dev_cb() (crypto2dev_port.c line ~1474), the 'if (g_tls_safe_mode) return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE;' guard has no comment at the call site. The explanation lives on the g_tls_safe_mode declaration ~130 lines above. A reader scanning the dispatch switch cannot see why HASH ops are suppressed without scrolling away. Add a brief inline comment referencing the wc_Sha256Copy / transcript-hash constraint.
